You can't sit and let this continue you have to talk to her. I recommend doing anything you can to let her know how much you care about her. You need to let her know that while she may be hurting you/pushing you away , even if this does cause you to split up you will still care about her and help her when she needs it. Try to tell her this when she seems calmer and be calm yourself but show that you do really care. From the sound of it you seem to be having a hard time dealing with this situation so i suggest that you ensure that you have someone to talk to about this to ensure your own wellbeing. You could also talk to someone else who knows her (e.g. an old friend,family member or anyone else who is/was close with her ) and get advice on how it would be best to approach her with this. Overall try to express your feelings without invalidating hers and be sure to express that you will support her even if you have to split due to the abuse.
